name: Cooler Stims
teaser: Five custom stims, each built for a different way to play — entry fragging, sustained healing, tanking, looting, limb repair. Now with their own models, icons, and in-hands skins. Everything configurable.
description_html:
Description

Five custom stims, each built around a different way to play. These stims add variety to the game where years of the same stims became stale.

Every stim has its own model, icon, and injector skin — in the stash, on the ground, and in your hands when you use it.

The Stims

  • APEX — the entry fragger. Big stamina pool, faster regen, and Stress Resistance for when bullets are flying. Health skill up while it runs, and Vitality levels for survivability. Energy crash and tunnel vision hit at 95 seconds, so don’t pop it early.
  • AEGIS — 9.5 health rate for a minute, and it stops all bleeds for 90 seconds. Pop it as a last resort or in a dire emergency. You pay for it with a hydration and stamina dip after.
  • IRON — the pack mule. +30 max stamina, faster regen, and a weight limit bump so you can actually haul ass out of raid, or make a quick escape. Small health and energy drain at the end.
  • ARGUS — the loot goblin special. Attention, perception and search all up for three and a half minutes. Tunnel vision and a hydration dip when it wears off.
  • GRAFT — a 5-charge trauma auto-injector. Fixes blacked and fractured limbs like a CMS. Light health regen while it works, then hands tremor and an energy dip.

Getting them

Therapist sells APEX and AEGIS at higher loyalty levels, they’re on the flea, and they spawn as loose loot and in medical containers.

Numbers not to your taste? config.json has every buff value, duration, price, and loyalty level.

Install Instructions
  1. Extract the archive
  2. Drop BOTH the BepInEx and SPT folders into your SPT root directory (1.4.0 adds a client plugin — the mod needs both halves)
  3. Buy from Therapist, hit the flea, or find them in raid
Known Limitations / Bugs
  • None currently known. If you find one, please report it (see Support tab).
